verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI document is published at https://cactuscompute.com/v1/openapi.json, and its description reads "Generate tool-calling training data, fine-tune Needle 3, and download the resulting models", matching the documented REST endpoints (/generations, /tool_schemas, /billing). The probe's 404s were only on unversioned or well-known paths, not on /v1/openapi.json, so they do not contradict the spec's existence.
